state: source_only_pending_independent_review; no arrays decoded, source implementation, fit, CV or allocation
scope: Additional arrival supervision for a shared motion representation; not new per-query privileged information or a shared recording-lag correction.

novelty.nearest_prior: Departure-only point boundary auxiliary was inconclusive; no direct ARR-supervised representation source found. Cohort owner confirms full-day cohort and target consistency used departures only.

preparation.point_selection: Preserve cached DEP capped sequence; select ARR in [landing,landing+5400s], same canonical sort/dedup and floor(linspace(0,n-1,128)). Then keep raw ground altitude code -123 and nonnegative speed. At least2 eligible points per flight; no BLOCK-based crop, mask, sampler or support selection.
preparation.population: All uniquely identified, mapped arrivals/departures on allowed dates satisfying input-only point rule. Supervision requires finite recorded implied block; report label-unavailable separately, no target-value threshold.
preparation.rotation_policy: Input-only count other same-aircraft movement anchors inside each full window. Primary population excludes windows containing any other movement anchor (arrival/departure), in either phase, before seeing labels. Report excluded coverage. This does not prove no unobserved later rotation; retain this limitation.
preparation.paired_time_scope: Opposite temporal halves months apart; remove any exact reused source observation (airport,hex,timestamp) across train/evaluation if encountered; fail on movementID overlap. Repeated aircraft across months is allowed (a shared representation), but no aircraft identity enters model.
preparation.phase_alignment: speed and stand distance are phase invariant. For sampled stand-distance derivative use +1 DEP / -1 ARR, so motion toward stand when ARR becomes away-from-stand under reversal. Phase is used only by this fixed transform and target orientation.
features: previous sampled ground-point pair known (strict dt>0 and dt<=120s)
fixed ten-airport one-hot (existing challenge airports); no fitted vocab or centering
preparation.point_weights: Each flight sums to one, regardless point count; no class balancing or target-dependent sampling.

targets.label_meaning: Recorded taxi-side boundary, not independently observed physical motion. No clipping, class threshold or target-dependent feature selection.
targets.arrival_label_provenance: Existing inblock_ms is reconstructed from supplied arrival taxiin in aircraft_rotation.read_movements. Verify against raw allowed-date ARR target; millisecond serialization bound<=0.001sec, no row-dependent relaxation.
targets.forbidden_tautology: Neither implied BLOCK nor movement-relative point time enters features. Perturb all label clocks in synthetic fixtures and demand bit-exact IDs/features/selection; only targets may change.

split.arrival_scope: Only fit-side dates; no held-side ARR supervision.
split.outer_firewall: Both sets are wholly within intersection of Jan/Jul allowed training months. Do not read Jan/Jul2025 departure files or any old/final ranking values.

model.kind: One fixed linear logistic point learner, intercept plus22 inputs (12 motion/geometry +10 fixed airport indicators). No neural encoder or downstream candidate.
model.controls: Same feature matrix definition, zero coefficient initialization, L-BFGS-B options and total training loss mass N_DEP. Only extra arrival supervision differs.
model.failure: Nonconvergence or nonfinite coefficients closes execution; no optimizer/lambda retry. Independent gradient and objective arithmetic fixtures required.

evaluation.primary: Held-date DEP mean of per-flight mean soft-label binary cross-entropy; same ordered rows for both arms.
evaluation.gate: Candidate relative loss improvement>=0.05 in BOTH transfer directions; paired whole-day2000-draw PCG64(20261013) interval for candidate-minus-control must have upper<0 separately in BOTH directions.
evaluation.bootstrap: Resample the six held UTC dates with replacement; retain all flights/points from each drawn date; aggregate flight-weighted loss. Report few-cluster limitation.
evaluation.no_tuning: No other regularizer, crop, window, loss weight, airport, classifier or transfer split after results.
evaluation.interpretation: Pass supports one fixed arrival-supervised representation Jan/Jul trial; does not establish selected-stack headroom or several-second gain. Fail closes only this specific low-cost transfer learner.

artifacts: input-only per-flight/index and bounded point feature packet
separate labels.parquet with allowed-date membership proof

budget.status: planning caps, not measured; preparation is separately bounded and reviewed

successor: Separate source-reviewed, one-seed Jan/Jul exact-parent comparison with shared motion training only; retain genuineCV and full serialization controls. Match departure-only optimization. No automatic fit, production or final change.
limitations: Recorded ARR inblock can lag physical stop substantially.
Ground missingness and phase/route coverage differ; a positive ARR-only classifier metric is insufficient.
Current full inputs already contain these motion signals; this tests finite-sample supervised representation transfer, not newly revealed per-row information.
A cheap point classifier cannot certify marginal improvement conditional on complete v80; honest training-date parent outputs were not established here.
